'''August 2000 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at KK's Kards and Komics, Pleasanton, CA on 20 August 2000. [[John Monroe]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1153">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ pleasonton-ca-9-20], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 August 2000
* '''Site:''' KK's Kards and Komics, Pleasanton, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[John Monroe]]
